How do I scan a food item?
Tap the scan icon on the Home screen, point your camera at the product\'s barcode or label, and NutriScan looks up its nutrition info automatically.
Can I scan a grocery receipt instead of one item at a time?
Yes. Use Receipt Capture to scan a whole receipt and log multiple items at once.
NutriGPT is an in-app AI assistant you can chat with for nutrition questions and personalized suggestions based on your logged data.
How do I log calories and exercises?
Open the Calories or Exercises tab to record meals and workouts; your daily totals update automatically.
Can I track nutrition for my family?
Yes. Add family members under Manage Family and switch between profiles when logging or scanning.
Where can I see my past scans?
Scan History keeps a record of every item you\'ve scanned, with the nutrition data attached.
What is the News tab for?
It surfaces nutrition and health articles curated for your profile.
How do I edit my profile?
Go to Settings then Profile Settings to update your name, avatar, and personal details.
Your data is stored securely and only used to power the app\'s features. See Terms and Conditions for details.
How do I change app language or theme?
Settings then Appearance and Language let you switch between light/dark and English/Arabic instantly.

string-array.item: Health is a state of complete harmony of the body, mind and spirit.
Eat food as your medicine, otherwise you will eat medicine as your food.
Hydration is the key to energy. Drink a fresh glass of water to kickstart your day!
Small healthy choices every day add up to massive lifetime transformations.
Nourish your body with real food; it\'s the only place you have to live.
A 30-minute brisk walk can boost your heart health and elevate your mood.
Consistency over perfection. Keep tracking your meals and stay mindful.
Track today, thank yourself tomorrow.
Proper sleep and adequate hydration build the foundation for vibrant energy.
Progress isn\'t always on the scale — energy and mood count too.
Colors on your plate mean vitamins in your body. Aim for a colorful meal!
Movement is medicine for your joints and clarity for your mind.
Drink water before you feel thirsty; stay proactive with your hydration.
Listen to your body\'s hunger cues and savor every single bite.
Your health is an investment, not an expense. Prioritize yourself today.
Fresh fruits and vegetables are natural boosters for your immune system.
Taking steps toward your goal counts, no matter how small they seem.
Skipping a log doesn\'t erase your progress. Just log the next one.
Consistency beats intensity — small wins, every single day.
Stretching for five minutes in the morning awakens your muscles and mind.
Mindful eating transforms food into genuine energy and vital vitality.
You don\'t have to be extreme, just consistent. Keep going strong!
Fueling your muscles with protein helps repair and build daily strength.
Replace sugary beverages with water or herbal tea for instant clarity.
A peaceful mind leads to a healthier body. Take time to relax today.
Strength doesn\'t come from what you can do occasionally, but from what you do consistently.
Fiber-rich meals keep your gut happy and your energy steady all day.
Celebrate every day you choose health. You are building a brighter future.
Good nutrition is a form of self-respect. Treat yourself right today!
Success is the sum of small habits repeated day in and day out.
